reviews.x: I absolutely LOVED this glitter. The jars are huge compared to similar items. I bought it to use as nail art and the mix of chunky and dust glitter gives the perfect effect. These nails are even more gorgeous in person. I tried to show different angles and lighting. It also was packaged well and the jars are taped for extra security. Don't hesitate, buy now!!

reviews.t: Glitter looks so pretty, used it for makeup!
reviews.x: The glitter is bomb!!! I have only tried 2 colors so far but so worth it! The reason for the 4 stars is due to packing the glitters come in a plastic container and they all come in a small thin box. Unfortunately one of the glitter was broken, lucky most was saved just needs a new container. I wished they at least put bubble wrap.

16 boxes shinny body glitter. It’s a mixture of larger pieces and small pieces, creating a natural and beautiful looking. All colors are great. Very easy to stick on skin, a little hard to wash off though. Great pieces for party, concerts or special makeup. And I just find it great for clay lover (you can use it to create a Milky Way scene or doll dress!).

I absolutely cannot believe how gorgeous these are. I might even use them for acrylic nails too but I’ll be using them for carnival makeup. The shipping was literally overnight. The colors are vibrant as you might can tell from the video. I’m in love!!!

These glitters are EVERYTHING!!! Period! You will not be disappointed, they come quickly, and it’s plenty in the containers! The packaging was nice, and the tops are taped shut! Thank you to this seller, I will be back again! Even tho this review was already written out automatically, these are my thoughts as well! Lol!
Love the colors. Tried on my nails for the first time. Acrylic, glitter, acrylic in that order lol. Also none of my jars were damaged

I love these pots of glitter! They were packaged perfectly and sealed, not a drop was spilled. Very impressive. You get a good amount of glitter in these pots, depending what you’re going to use them for. (I plan to use mine for nail art.) There are tiny glitter flakes and larger ones that give you that chunky look, if you like that look. Overall completely satisfied, will buy again when these are finished.

reviews.t: Gorgeous Chunky Glitter For Gel Manicures!
reviews.x: I was pleasantly surprised by this glitter.... it comes in 16 small round plastic containers. All 16 glitters are different from one another in color and color-shift. Also, the glitter in each pot is of different size, shape, and color combinations. I use this glitter for my gel manicures. Beautiful, will definitely buy more!

reviews.t: Beautiful mixed colors of glitter and bigger than I thought
reviews.x: The colors are excellent-vibrant and shiny, especially for the price, and the quality is great(not to thin, not to thick-I am using for Tumblers, they will be mixed with mica powder and epoxy. They were packaged in each plastic container that reseals and they were each taped-so nothing spilled-YAY!

reviews.t: Beautiful glitters BUT not for the face or for kids !!
reviews.x: The grlitters are gorgeous, superbes colors ! Just very hard and sometimes big, I ordered them to use in my face painting but I wouldn't use them with kids, too risky, if they rub taht in their eyes they can really damage their eyes ! I will use other glitters

This glitter is great, so many good color combos to choose from. It's just a little hard to get out of the containers, still trying to figure that out. I put it on with pastie glue- you could also use other types of body glue or eyelash glue.

reviews.t: Very poor value, but nice glitter
reviews.x: This glitter is perfect for festivals or makeup and the colors, shapes, and sizes are great. I gave it 3 stars though because it's crazy expensive for glitter. I mean, glitter is basically cut up pieces of plastic. But it's great otherwise.

I loved loved loved the packaging, it came neat and efficient. Wrapped in plastic. Nothing was opened or had spilled out. The colors are fabulous and I'm super excited to use them tomorrow on a client! Definitely will be ordering more!!!!
This glitter shows up so well!  The colors are vibrant and just because the jar is small, there is PLENTY to go around!  5 of us used these for 5 days to glitter our face and shoulders and chest!
This glitter set is amazing.  The variety of colors is great and I like that it is not too chunky.  I used some of the glitter for floating makeup brushes and will use the others for nail art.

reviews.t: I do recommend this product you should buy
reviews.x: I love this product especially the colors. The colors are very bright and come in differnt varieties of colors. I use thia product in my acrylic nails and it makes the nails very pretty.
I received a total of 16 boxes of powder, each box is very beautiful, the key is that there are so many so cheap, super value, I will recommend my friends to buy.
I am totally in love with all the different color it brings, able to puse for so many purposes. The packaging is a little wacky it could be better. Thanks again!
I love this glitter and have used it in bath bombs but i need to know if it contains any aluminum and cant seem to find the information
Purchased it for nail art. It weighs more than I expected. I even used it to decorate cups, mobile phone cases and other small things.
The packaging was GREAT. The containers does come taped around the lids which was super nice. The glitter itself was awesome.
So excited about these glitters. I just started resin projects and i used these in some coasters i made, OMG THE SPARKLES!!
[[VIDEOID:43545a5fbb0b6737edffe3484d93f112]] Product came just as described. Can’t wait to try these out with my makeup!!!
Two containers arrived damnged and fell out of the plastic into the box :( but I would order again for the quality.
My sister-in-law dresses as a mermaid for children's parties so I bought this as a gift for her. She loves it!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the vibrant, gorgeous colors and the variety of color combinations in the set.
Many reviewers say the glitter is packaged well and sealed, with nothing spilled or damaged.
Several reviewers note the containers hold a good amount of glitter and are larger or more generous than expected.
A few reviewers mention the glitter is hard to get out of the containers or hard to wash off.
Some reviewers report issues with packaging damage or consider the product poor value for the price.
